# Bloub engine

Unmodified TypeScript engine from `jeremy-prt/bloub`, copyright 2026 Jérémy Perret, MIT. Full required notice: LICENSE. Source baseline: upstream b4bb3c1, imported from the maintained reference on 2 October 2026.

Do not edit this engine to change Kea's face. `components/sparky-presence.tsx` adapts SVG output to React Native and adds a separate capsule mouth. Geometry, eye paths, expressions and motion remain unchanged. The adapter uses white ink in dark mode and black ink in light mode.

Bloub recreates the visual behaviour of the x.ai bot as an exercise. It is not affiliated with x.ai. The MIT license covers this code, not the design it imitates; Kea makes no endorsement claim.
